text:
PEM::policy
Description
This command allows you to check the name of a policy or check if the
policy is being evaluated for the first time.
Note: the Policy Enforcement Manager license is required for
functionality to work.
Syntax
PEM
::
policy
initial
PEM
::
policy
name
PEM::policy initial
returns true or false depending on whether the policy is being
evaluated for the first time for the flow, or is being re-evaluated
for the flow.
PEM::policy name
returns the name of the PEM policy.
Examples
when
PEM_POLICY
{
if
{[
PEM
::
policy
initial
]}
{
/*
Commands
to
run
during
the
first
time
the
policy
is
evaluated.

}
else

to

during
policy
re-evaluation.
*/
}
/*

to

during
policy
eval
and
re-eval
time.
*/
}
